title: Repeating Witch Grid
description: A 4x4 grid of identical illustrations featuring a witch with long dark hair in a teal dress and wide-brimmed hat, standing in a red landscape with floating fish. Most panels show her holding a glass orb containing a red fish; one panel shows a blue fish and another shows a skull inside the orb.
prompt: A 4x4 grid of repeating illustrations of a witch with long flowing dark hair wearing a teal dress and large wide-brimmed hat, standing in profile holding a transparent glass orb containing a red fish, set against a red stylized landscape with floating fish and purple mountain shapes, one panel shows a blue fish and another a skull inside the orb, hand-drawn line art with watercolor texture
